The contract is initially for 10 months, up to 30.09.2027. The essential qualification is a three-year Graduate degree in a relevant subject with three years' work experience, or a Post-Graduate degree in a relevant subject. how_to_apply: Download and fill the prescribed application form enclosed with the notice.
Send the scanned, signed application form, with self-attested copies of all documents in a single PDF, to [email protected].
Write the subject line "Application – PTS-III – ICMR VSP Project".

On the day of interview, bring the following. Candidates who fail to produce these documents will not be allowed to appear for the interview.

The appointment is whole-time. The appointee shall not take up any other paid or unpaid assignment or private practice during the contract. The appointee shall perform duties assigned by the PI / competent authority without any additional allowance. The appointee may be required to undergo a medical examination by the designated medical authority. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview/written test or for joining. Leave will be governed by DoP&T OM No. 12016/3/84-Estt.(L) dated 12.04.1985, as amended from time to time. False information or suppression of material facts will lead to cancellation of candidature or termination. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Results will be published on the AIIMS Raipur website (www.aiimsraipur.edu.in), and selected candidates will be informed by e-mail. Check the website for any change in the date or time of the interview. For queries, contact Dr. Ashish Sharma, Assistant Professor, Department of Neurosurgery, AIIMS Raipur, Chhattisgarh – 492 099, at [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Raipur
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Raipur is located at G.E. Road, Tatibandh, Raipur – 492 099 (CG). This post sits in an ICMR-funded project led by Principal Investigator Dr. Ashish Sharma, Assistant Professor, Department of Neurosurgery. The project's technical team is at IIT Bhilai, and the post is co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives two alternative qualifications for the post, as per ICMR norms. The relevant subjects named for the Graduate degree are Life Sciences, Radiography or Medical Imaging Technology, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology and Allied Health Sciences. Both degrees must be from a recognised university. The notice does not list subjects for the Post-Graduate route beyond "a relevant subject". The desirable qualifications printed in the notice are: Experience in handling CT/CBCT imaging data (DICOM), anonymisation and PACS. Familiarity with medical image viewing / 3D segmentation software (e.g. 3D Slicer, Mimics). Experience in clinical research data management (eCRF / REDCap) and Good Clinical Practice (GCP). Good communication skills in English. The age limit is not exceeding 35 years as on the date of interview, relaxable as per Government of India norms. The notice does not print the relaxation amounts for any category. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details.

rows.essential_qualification: Three-year Graduate degree in a relevant subject with three years' work experience; OR Post-Graduate degree in a relevant subject; plus working knowledge of computers (MS Word, Excel)
rows.desirable: Experience in CT/CBCT imaging data, 3D segmentation software familiarity, research data management and GCP, good English communication

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated emoluments are ₹33,600 per month, made up of ₹28,000 plus 20% HRA, as per ICMR norms. No allowance other than these emoluments is admissible, and the appointee is not entitled to benefits available to regular employees of AIIMS Raipur. The appointment is purely on contract, initially for 10 months from the date of joining (up to 30.09.2027). It can be extended depending on performance, the requirement of the project and availability of funds, up to the duration of the project. If not extended, it lapses automatically. Either side may terminate it at any time with one month's notice or one month's salary in lieu, without assigning any reason. It may also be terminated if the appointee fails to complete the first three months to the satisfaction of the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raipur Project Technical Support-III Job Description
content_sections.text: Collection, anonymisation and management of retrospective CT/CBCT datasets for AI model development. Maintenance of the study database (eCRFs) and ensuring accurate data recording and reporting. Assisting in prospective patient recruitment, consent, follow-up and coordination of postoperative imaging. Coordinating data exchange between the clinical team at AIIMS Raipur and the technical team at IIT Bhilai. Ensuring that the study is conducted as per protocol, SOPs and GCP guidelines. Documentation, report preparation and any other project-related work assigned by the PI.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Raipur Project Technical Support-III
content_sections.text: Download and fill the prescribed application form enclosed with the notice. Send the scanned, signed application form, with self-attested copies of all documents in a single PDF, to [email protected] . Write the subject line "Application – PTS-III – ICMR VSP Project". Provide the e-mail ID and contact number of your previous project in-charge(s) for verification of experience. Make sure the previous project in-charge(s) respond to AIIMS Raipur's queries. Failure to respond makes the candidate ineligible. Send the application so that it is received by 3 December 2026, 11:59 PM. Incomplete applications, or applications received after the last date, will not be considered. On the day of interview, bring the following. Candidates who fail to produce these documents will not be allowed to appear for the interview. The duly filled application form. All original mark sheets and certificates (education and experience). One original photo ID issued by a Government authority (Aadhaar / PAN / Voter ID / Driving Licence). One set of self-attested photocopies.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The list of shortlisted candidates will be sent by e-mail, and no separate call letters or admit cards will be issued. Selection will be based on performance in the interview and/or written test. A written test, if held, will consist of multiple-choice objective questions only. If the number of applications is large, the interview may extend to the next day, or a screening test or other shortlisting criteria may be adopted. The decision of the competent authority will be final. The interview date, time and venue will be communicated later to shortlisted candidates.
